title: On T-positive links
summary: T-positive links form a subset of strongly quasipositive links that strictly contains the set of all non-split braid positive links. Analogous to Baader's characterisation of positive links as precisely the strongly quasipositive and homogeneous links, we show that T-positive links are precisely the strongly quasipositive links that are the closures of T-homogeneous braids. This complements previous characterizations of T-positive links by Rudolph and Banfield as links arising as boundaries of positive Hopf-plumbed baskets, or closures of staircase braids.
